settings.title: Home Design
settings.description: Configure content width, desktop top nav, and footer business notice for official sirsoft-basic.

fields.hide_desktop_top_nav_hint: Hides Header board/home/shop tab nav via CSS (official theme compatible).
fields.hide_header_board_slugs_json: Board slugs to hide in header (JSON array)
fields.hide_header_board_slugs_json_hint: JSON array. Empty ([]) shows all boards. Default is [].
fields.footer_link_groups_json_hint: JSON array [{title, links:[{label,href,icon?}]}]. Icons auto-enriched for common hrefs. Empty keeps theme defaults.
fields.business_info_enabled_hint: When ON, shows sirsoft-ecommerce basic_info (company/CEO/numbers/address/phone/email) above the footer. Empty ecommerce info yields an empty block.
fields.header_search_icon_mode: Search: icon only (slide panel on click)
fields.header_search_icon_mode_hint: Default ON. Hides the center search input and shows a right-side icon. Click slides a search panel down (same as feat theme).
fields.header_theme_click_toggle: Dark mode: click to toggle (no dropdown)
fields.header_theme_click_toggle_hint: Default ON. Sun/moon icon click immediately toggles light↔dark. No dropdown menu.
fields.hide_header_board_slugs: Board slugs to hide from header
fields.hide_header_board_slugs_hint: Comma-separated slugs. Leave empty to show all boards. Comma-separated slugs (e.g. qna, inquiry). Filters desktop+mobile+더보기; JS fallback if needed.
